atoms.a: These are known as a man’s best friend because of how loyal they are. They love to go for a walk.
These animals love to laze around in the sun and climb up their tower. They like to chase mice.
You can’t take these animals for a walk as they live underwater, but they are very pretty and come in a lot of colours.

Nature
